_comment: Tool policy for the self-briefing planner quartermaster.sh runs unattended.
Narrower than worker-settings.json on purpose: the planner reads code and
writes exactly one file (the brief). It never edits a repo, never commits,
This matters more here than for the implementer, because the planner's
prompt contains a Linear ticket description — text any workspace member can
edit. An allow-list is what keeps a poisoned description from becoming
actions: everything absent from `allow` fails immediately rather than
prompting, so nothing blocks waiting for a human who is asleep.
Edit/MultiEdit are deliberately absent. Write is the only mutation the
planner needs, and the brief path is dictated to it.
